limiter: Hub-3 OBLIQUITY on the arm and the overhead acromion, not the stack order: a J3 axis through GH meets the arm skin 30-39 deg off its normal at the seats where the knuckle reaches (wd 46-70), so the 20 mm O20 disc spans 12-16 mm of height (hub 3 0.49-0.69 in band); seats at the deltoid crest (wd >= 75-90, obliquity 16 deg, hub 3 0.82) lose reach (0.70 median vs 0.77) and overhead poses push hub 3 / hub 2 up (C6 hub 3 F 81 set by elevation 165). Reach loss at C6 (fast, 160 ws): 22 fold (th 17 folded / 129-147 stretched, K's own span b1 + b2 - 5 = 69.2), 10 contact; overhead 0 of 12 ws, 2 of 17 named.
